hi sofia, my answers

1) i do a coding assistant that suggest the billing codes from the clinical notes. around 45 medical coders use it every day and the time for each note go down like 40%. i design the prompts for extract, the screen for review and the fallback that send the notes with low confidence to a senior coder.
2) we have 250 notes that senior coders already code, is our test set, we run it in every change. the exact match accuracy go from 74% to 89%, also we see how many times the coders change the suggestion.
3) the notes that say a disease only for discard it. we put a step of negation before the coding and the false positives go away almost all.
4) the lookup of codes in the official catalog is normal queries to database, the model only propose candidates from the text of the note.
5) Montevideo, Uruguay. 37 usd/h. english 8 of 10. 7 hours same time with US east.

thanks,
Martina
